environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic demo-session fixtures only

BIO-OPS-002-AC01.finding: Signed alpha and beta claims resolve only to their separately configured backend tenant identifiers; missing beta configuration fails closed rather than substituting alpha.

BIO-OPS-002-AC02.finding: Real-host coverage presents a tenant-A person identifier through tenant B and receives the same not-found result as an unknown identifier.

BIO-OPS-002-AC03.finding: Role switching changes visible navigation/actions, while backend permission grants remain tenant, actor and role scoped.

BIO-OPS-002-AC04.finding: Context changes use the shared ADR-0003 envelope, canonical identifiers, derived prior-actor attribution and a closed detail allowlist; audit succeeds before cookie commit. Decision 8 narrowly accepts the synthetic session's bounded restart residual.

BIO-OPS-002-AC05.finding: Unknown hosts and unconfigured claimed tenants fail closed with no fallback context.

follow_ups.summary: An API restart can lose the in-memory context-change audit while the bounded synthetic session cookie survives. Decision 8 permits only this named demo-session mechanism and is not precedent for real credentials, grants or authorization effects.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC05 pass. The four-round remediation chain closes real tenant switching, fail-closed mapping, canonical audit shape and caller-controlled attribution. ADR-0003 Decision 8 and freeze snapshot 1.1.11 authoritatively record the remaining synthetic-only restart residual, independently confirmed by Seyi and Zainab.
